import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int N, M, P;
    static int[] num = new int[503];
    static int[] V = new int[503];
    static int[][] C = new int[503][503];
    static long[][] dp = new long[503][503];
    static long[][] ans = new long[503][503];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();

        num[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= M; ++i) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= M; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                num[i] = (int)((num[i] + (long)num[j - 1] * num[i - j] % P * (i + 1) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P);
                int sum = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= i; ++k) {
                    sum += Math.abs(j - k);
                }
                V[i] = (int)((V[i] + (long)V[j - 1] * num[i - j] % P * (i + 1) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]
                        + (long)V[i - j] * num[j - 1] % P * (i + 1) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]
                        + (long)num[i - j] * num[j - 1] % P * sum % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k + i + 1 <= N + 1 && k + j <= M; ++k) {
                    int ni = i + k + 1;
                    int nj = j + k;
                    long val = ((long)dp[i][j] * C[M - j][k] % P * num[k]) % P;
                    dp[ni][nj] = (dp[ni][nj] + val) % P;
                    long add_ans = ((long)ans[i][j] * C[M - j][k] % P * num[k] + (long)dp[i][j] * C[M - j][k] % P * V[k]) % P;
                    ans[ni][nj] = (ans[ni][nj] + add_ans) % P;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans[N + 1][M]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
